question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

27, 29, ?, 182, 730, 3652
solution:
The logic followed here is :** Multiplied by a number series starting with (1) and added (2) subsequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bdad2941deb1858585410ec8ae6e46a55eb5cf0d0f64d30a1605bbeb658721b.png] 

Hence, **"60"** is the correct answer.
